name: Fake bank KYC or account-block message
description: Claims your bank account, card or wallet will be blocked unless you update KYC through a link or by sharing an OTP.
keywords: bank account blocked suspended kyc update pan aadhaar link card expired netbanking
examples: Your SBI account will be blocked today. Update KYC now at the link
actions: Do not click the link or share any OTP, PIN or CVV.
Call your bank using the number on your card or official app.
Block the sender and report the message.

name: UPI collect request or refund scam
description: Asks you to approve a payment request, scan a QR code or enter your UPI PIN to receive money or a refund.
keywords: upi refund collect request qr scan pin cashback gpay phonepe paytm receive money
examples: Scan this QR code to receive your refund of 4999 rupees
actions: You never need a PIN or QR scan to receive money. Decline the request.
If you already paid, call 1930 immediately and tell your bank.
Report the UPI ID in your payment app.

name: Digital arrest or fake police and agency call
description: Someone posing as police, CBI, customs or a court says you are linked to a crime and must stay on a video call or pay to avoid arrest.
keywords: arrest police cbi customs narcotics court warrant video call fir parcel illegal money laundering
examples: A parcel in your name contains drugs. Stay on the video call or you will be arrested
actions: No real agency arrests people over video call or takes payment to clear a case. Hang up.
Do not install apps or transfer money.
Report it on cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.

name: Fake job or online task scam
description: Offers easy work-from-home pay, then asks for a registration fee or for you to deposit money to unlock earnings.
keywords: job work from home earn daily income task like video review part time registration fee telegram whatsapp salary
examples: Earn 5000 daily by liking videos. Pay a small registration fee to start
actions: Genuine employers do not charge to hire you.
Do not move the chat to Telegram or pay any fee.
Report the account and block it.

name: Courier or customs fee scam
description: Says a parcel is held and asks for a small fee or address confirmation through a link.
keywords: courier parcel delivery customs held fee address confirm tracking package redelivery
examples: Your parcel is held. Pay 49 rupees at this link to reschedule delivery
actions: Check the tracking number on the courier's official site.
Do not pay through links received in messages.
Delete the message.

name: Lottery, prize or gift scam
description: Says you won a prize or gift and must pay a fee or share details to claim it.
keywords: won lottery prize winner lucky draw gift claim congratulations reward tax fee
examples: Congratulations, you won 25 lakh. Pay the processing fee to claim
actions: You cannot win a contest you did not enter.
Never pay a fee to receive a prize.
Block and delete.

name: Electricity or utility disconnection scam
description: Threatens that power, gas or a connection will be cut tonight unless you pay or call a number.
keywords: electricity bill disconnected tonight power gas utility unpaid call officer pay immediately
examples: Your electricity will be cut tonight. Call this officer and pay now
actions: Check your bill in the official provider app or website.
Do not call the number in the message.
Report it to your provider.

name: Investment or crypto scam
description: Promises guaranteed or very high returns, often through a private group, and pushes you to deposit more.
keywords: investment crypto trading guaranteed returns profit double stock tips group usdt platform withdraw deposit
examples: Guaranteed 40 percent weekly returns. Join our private trading group
actions: No legitimate investment guarantees returns. Stay out.
Check that the platform is registered with SEBI.
Do not deposit more to unlock withdrawals.
